producedBy: Session C Part B — LANE TRACKER
whatThisIs: Tracker rows whose subject is a STANDING FRESHNESS OBLIGATION rather than a one-shot piece of work, handed off for conversion. This lane does not edit scheduler code; it names the rows, the record class, the subject and what each obligation still needs before it can carry a next_due.
theTestApplied: lib/control-plane/scheduler/obligation.ts says a FreshnessObligation is 'deliberately NOT a WorkItem — a WorkItem is a piece of work with a completion contract; this is a standing obligation that never completes'. A row converts ONLY if it names a record class, names a subject, and describes a condition that RECURS. A defect that is fixed once and stays fixed is a WorkItem and is NOT on this list, however much it looks like scheduling.
whatWasRefused: A keyword sweep over the 317 non-Needs-Sean open rows matched 28 on recurrence-plus-record-class language. Reading them showed the match was mostly noise — defects, research corpora and one-shot builds. Converting on that signal would have been effort presented as evidence, so the list below is hand-verified and is deliberately six rows rather than twenty-eight. The remaining rows are ordinary open executable work and are NOT obligations; see docs/tracker-owner-view.md and docs/tracker.md.

obligations.subject: Springfield, New Hampshire — eight enumerated bodies, recorded KNOWN_UNCOVERED
obligations.routeId: town HTML route (the live one); the iCal export is the route being replaced
obligations.whyItRecurs: The town iCal export is capped at the OLDEST 50 events and stops at 2024-11-07, so it goes stale by construction rather than by accident. Six different views all return the identical capped set.
needsBeforeItCanCarryANextDue: an adapter for the live HTML route (the iCal route must not be the cadence source — it cannot go fresh)
an observedChangeRateHours reading, which needs at least two observations of the HTML route
a declaredCycleHours if the town publishes a meeting schedule
obligations.readerImpactAt: each meeting start for the eight bodies; no single date

obligations.subject: all eleven meetings sources — this is an architectural obligation, not a per-source one
obligations.whyItRecurs: Every meetings adapter clips to the same 90 days at fetch time and the snapshot stamps generatedAt minutes later, so every 90d-clipped source lands within about a day and a half of its own edge PERMANENTLY, by construction. Eight of eleven sit under 14 days of window headroom and will again tomorrow.
needsBeforeItCanCarryANextDue: a decision on whether headroom is a property of the source or of the fetch window — the answer changes what the obligation's subject is
the fetch window as a per-source parameter rather than a shared constant, or the obligation is unschedulable because every source shares one clock
obligations.readerImpactAt: continuous — the window edge moves daily

obligations.subject: the committed meetings snapshot itself
obligations.whyItRecurs: Two clocks decide two different things and only one has an alarm. A frozen snapshot loses reader-visible rows one day at a time and nothing goes red, because the staleness guard measures a source's oldest row against the snapshot's OWN generatedAt rather than against now.
needsBeforeItCanCarryANextDue: the authoritative freshness clock per RULING 218 — this obligation is the reason that ruling exists and cannot be scheduled against the snapshot's self-reported time
a reader-visible-row count as the measured quantity, so the obligation is about what a reader loses rather than about file age
obligations.readerImpactAt: continuous — rows fall out of the serving window daily

obligations.subject: Morris County, New Jersey municipal bodies
obligations.routeId: pnpm roster:stale against the Morris County Clerk's certified winners
obligations.whyItRecurs: Rosters drift against certification continuously: 45 certified winners are missing from rosters this project DOES hold, and 90 more belong to municipalities held with no roster at all. Each new certification cycle re-opens the same comparison.
needsBeforeItCanCarryANextDue: the certification calendar as the declaredCycleHours source — a roster obligation keyed to an election cycle should not be scheduled on an observed change rate
a per-municipality subjectId, because 'Morris County' is too coarse to dispatch and too coarse to report

obligations.subject: Central Arizona Water Conservation District — four Pima County seats
obligations.whyItRecurs: The board is popularly elected and serves every reader in 85641 and 85701. All four Pima seats carry terms expiring 12-31-2026, and the seats recur on a fixed cycle after that. The ballot corpus contains no CAWCD contest at all.
needsBeforeItCanCarryANextDue: a route to the contest — no adapter reaches CAWCD today, so this is an acquisition obligation before it is a freshness one

obligations.subject: the CivicPlus client base — the tenant list this product resolves towns against
obligations.whyItRecurs: The legacy list covers about 12% of CivicPlus customers and most of it went stale in 2020. A vendor's client base changes continuously and every town missing from the list is a town whose meetings the product cannot find.
needsBeforeItCanCarryANextDue: the detection method itself — this is an obligation whose route does not exist yet
a denominator for 'the client base', or coverage of it measures our own output
obligations.readerImpactAt: continuous — a missing town is a reader with no meetings
obligations.note: This row's Opened on is UNKNOWN: its opened-ledger entry was reconstructed on 2026-08-21 with no stamped day and names the session 'Prompt B', which carries no date. Not guessed.

obligations.subject: Tom Horne, Arizona Superintendent of Public Instruction
obligations.routeId: azed.gov officeholder page (BLOCKED_CURRENTLY behind a Cloudflare managed challenge)
obligations.whyItRecurs: A managed challenge is a transport state, not a permission one, and transport states change. RULING 182: 'could not fetch' is never 'not allowed'. The host's permission was already settled as ALLOWED at rung 4 in docs/sources.md, so this route is due for re-attempt on a cadence rather than closed.
needsBeforeItCanCarryANextDue: a tracker row of its own — this is a SPLIT out of OWN03 and has no id yet; LANE REGISTRY or the integration owner should mint one rather than this lane inventing an id it cannot claim in docs/tracker-opened.json

an alternate representation to try, per RULING 206: the record owed is a portrait of this officeholder, never that URL — the office's own newsroom, the State Board of Education, and a first-party press kit are all unwalked
a minimum-edge check in the obligation itself: the currently-held image is 60px against MIN_PORTRAIT_EDGE 96, so even a successful re-fetch of the same asset does not discharge this
obligations.readerImpactAt: continuous — the Officials surface renders a named gap for this officeholder meanwhile
obligations.whyItIsHereAndNotInTheOwnerQueue: OWN03 presented Horne as one of nine portraits awaiting the author's approval. He was never queued: data/photos/door2-statewide-executives-2026-08-28.json records decode ok:false, reason NOT_AN_IMAGE, detail 'no image signature - it begins <!DOCTYPE html>...<title>Just a moment', 5796 bytes. Approving an image the system never read is not a decision anybody can take, so this is hunt work and not owner work. OWN03's card is corrected and stays NEEDS_SEAN under RULING 55 for the nine that are real.

notClosedByThisHandoff: RULING 208 — naming an obligation does not discharge the record obligation behind it, and none of these rows is closed by appearing here. Each stays OPEN in docs/tracker-working.csv until the conversion actually lands.
